notes.title: Update patch to split save data
notes.notes:
Due to a part of the save data of PC version Exit 8 and Exit 8 VR were shared in common, an update patch is released to split these save data.
By applying this update, all previous save data will not be loaded and will start as a new game.
If you wish to use your previous save data, kindly refer to the steps below.

How to load your previous save data:
1. Access to "C:\Users\USERNAME\AppData\Local".
  (Change USERNAME to your PC username)
2. Copy "Exit8" folder and rename the copied folder to "Exit8VR".
3. Restart Exit 8 VR and enjoy!
